items.title: Astera Labs Stock Jumped 12% Yesterday. The Street Sees 14% More Upside, Here’s Why.
items.summary: Key TakeawaysSector Rally: Astera Labs stock jumped 12% on Monday, September 21, closing at $341 as a broad semiconductor rally lifted AMD past a $1 trillion market cap and sent Intel up more than 13%. Street Split: the 26 analysts TIKR tracks on Astera Labs stock split 12 buys, 7 outperforms, and 7 holds, with a mean target of $390 sitting 14% above Monday’s close.

items.title: Intel (INTC) Sees AI CPU Demand Squeeze As CEO Flags 50% Fulfillment
items.summary: Intel (NasdaqGS: INTC) and rival CPU suppliers reported stronger AI related order interest after Meta’s Muse agent news in September 2026. Intel’s CEO said current CPU production is meeting only about 50% of customer demand for AI workloads, indicating tight supply. Chipmakers tied to Muse driven AI compute needs flagged rising pressure on CPU capacity planning across upcoming production cycles.
